name: IAM Identity Context
purpose: adapt authenticated IAM session identity into a small immutable WebEngine runtime context without becoming an identity or authorization authority

domainContext.rule: WebEngine does not normalize or infer IAM domain identity

sessionTransport.rule: session token is not copied into WebEngine identity context

anonymousContext.rule: anonymous identity is not equivalent to an AccessCore deny decision

managementTier.meaning: effective IAM user-management tier for the requested domain
mustNot: be treated as an AccessCore authorization decision

failure.403: authenticated session lacks requested IAM domain membership; adapter error, not application authorization result
failure.malformedSuccess: fail closed; do not invent identity

rules: IAM remains the sole identity/authentication/session authority
WebEngine may transport and expose normalized IAM identity context only
WebEngine never stores passwords or raw IAM bearer/session tokens
identity context is immutable runtime data, not canonical IAM state
IAM management tiers are user-management claims only
UI identity state is not a backend security boundary
the public /iam/ projection is separate from the canonical /app/iam/ machine-interface root
